title: Two-span beam: settlement of the interior support

source.work: McGuire, W., Gallagher, R. H., Ziemian, R. D., Matrix Structural Analysis
source.notes: input data and targets read on the cited pages; nothing of the source is reproduced

analysis: Plane (x-y) problem of the source modelled in 3D with the global Y axis vertical, so that the source's x, y and theta_z are the model's X, Y and rz. In-plane bending is about local z for every member (default orientation), hence the source's I is the section's Iz. Beam of Example 4.8 along x: a (0), b (8 m), c (13 m). ab: A = 6e3 mm^2, Iz = 200e6 mm^4, J = 300e3 mm^4; bc: A = 4e3 mm^2, Iz = 50e6 mm^4, J = 100e3 mm^4; E = 200,000 MPa, nu = 0.3. The source omits bending normal to the plane: Iy is a placeholder (= Iz) that does not influence the targets. Supports as Example 5.6 (a pin, b roller, c fixed). Support b settles 15 mm (imposed uy = -15 mm); no other load. First order.
